recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No current FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-37465; any remaining concern would be historical publication/package maintenance outside this current-spec reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-37465 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-I request to correct canonical.value's generated primitive type metadata from string to canonical or uri, with the reporter noting the same snapshot-generation issue on other primitive types added in R4.
initial_application: No existing combined-branch Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-37465 was found, and no explicit core source commit with that Jira key was found. The application appears to have happened through primitive profile generation/publication: R4B and R5 history files now have canonical.value based on uri.value with structuredefinition-fhir-type canonical, and the affected peer primitive profiles now carry their own primitive names.
additional_context: The authoritative primitive source defines canonical as uri-based and the datatype page links to generated canonical profile definitions. Current CI, R5, and R4B canonical.profile.json all report canonical.value with base uri.value, fhirType canonical, and FHIRPath System.String code. Zulip confirms the reporter framed the problem as a snapshot/differential mismatch, Confluence records the FHIR-I approval, and FHIR-33310 supports treating similar primitive value complaints as already-fixed generation glitches while preserving the FHIRPath System.String code.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current FHIR source and generated/published conformance surfaces already satisfy the Jira request, so changing source prose or generated history would be redundant.

related_jiras.note: Related primitive profile complaint about unsignedInt.value; its resolution says R4B/R5/CI already had the relevant fhir-type extension fixed.
Adjacent structuredefinition-fhir-type rendering issue for Resource.id already has its own Issue-Reconcile-Key commit on the combined branch and was not decided again.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue asking to correct canonical.value's fhir-type from string to canonical or uri, with a note that other R4-added primitives were similarly affected.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes final WG intent and scopes reconciliation to primitive StructureDefinition snapshot generation rather than new datatype semantics.

evidence_items.summary: The primitive source defines canonical as based on uri with XML xs:anyURI, JSON string, and regex \\S*, while the datatype page links to generated canonical profile definitions.
evidence_items.learned: The current authoritative datatype source is in build scope and already supplies the correct primitive basis for generated canonical profiles.

evidence_items.summary: Generated R4B and R5 profile history has canonical.value based on uri.value with structuredefinition-fhir-type valueUrl canonical.
evidence_items.learned: The generated conformance history now reflects the exact correction requested by FHIR-37465.

evidence_items.learned: The reporter's parallel primitive snapshot concern has also been resolved on the relevant generated surfaces.
